Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
The new printing of Delaying Tactics does not have the line All
Kindred in it, so can allies use it?

Robert Scythe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Robert Scythe wrote:
>
> The new printing of Delaying Tactics does not have the line All
> Kindred in it, so can allies use it?

It costs a blood, so only minions that can pay the blood cost can play it.
This excludes all allies currently printed.

I had a feeling that this would be the case (hence the question)
however, if the Herald of Topheth reacts to a referendum by playing
Treachery ( and is considered a vampire through to the resolution of
the card) wouldn't he be eligible to play Delaying Tactics or Surprise
Influence during that time?

Robert Scythe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
The Herald can only play "cards requiring basic Daimoinon [dai], Potence [pot]
and/or Presence [pre] as a vampire".
